# Kuailu AI CRM | Product Overview

Kuailu AI CRM is an AI-powered customer relationship management platform designed to reduce manual data entry and help sales teams focus on customer engagement and closing deals.

| Capability | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Connected sales data | Connect CRM workflows with ERP, finance and marketing tools. |
| AI-assisted selling | Support prospect discovery, personalized outreach, customer insights and sales guidance. |
| Automated records | Capture interaction data, follow-up activity and opportunity-stage changes. |
| Sales visibility | Provide dashboards, reports and insights across leads, opportunities and customers. |
| Process coverage | Support the journey from lead generation and customer follow-up to opportunity and order management. |
